title: refactor(plugin-form,types): the master-detail form's `details` entry is the spec's closed entry, by reference (objectui#11396)
body:
Fixes #11396
Clause-②: no — the published `MasterDetailDetailConfig` keeps its accept set: the derived type is `Equal` to the hand-written interface it replaces (a one-off compile below proves the FROM and TO shapes identical, member for member), so only the type's definition moves, and the changeset is the empty-frontmatter declaration.

`@objectstack/spec` 17.6.0 judges `ComponentPropsMap['object-master-detail-form'].details` as an array of CLOSED entries (objectstack-ai/objectstack#21215, `a29a0ea555`): `childObject` required, `columns` the spec's inline grid column, an undeclared key refused by name. `@object-ui/types` already took the whole props row by reference, so both published zod faces give the spec's verdict on an entry. The TypeScript face in `@object-ui/plugin-form`, `MasterDetailDetailConfig`, restated the entry by hand, and the console parity row still said the spec row is `z.array(z.unknown())`. This PR makes the TypeScript face follow the spec entry by reference, makes the prose true, and pins both.

Dispatched under claim `5982160146` (`domain:spec`, size S; a re-dispatch of the same claim). Session: `https://claude.ai/code/session_01CPvhwGcirXqBGEdPSb72TZ`.

## What changes

- `packages/plugin-form/src/MasterDetailForm.tsx`: `MasterDetailDetailConfig` was an `interface` with eleven hand-written members. It is now a type DERIVED from the spec's entry — the element type of `ObjectMasterDetailFormProps['details']`, which is the spec's `z.input` authoring face (what a document writes), imported type-only from `@objectstack/spec/ui` — with ONE member omitted by name, `sortField` (the fork, below). The docblock states the fork and where each member lands in the renderer. The two imports only the interface used (`GridColumn` from `@object-ui/fields`, `InlineMode` from `./deriveMasterDetail`) are gone from this file; every other line is unchanged. The `amountField` → grid `totalField` hand-off is untouched (the same six-key grid object, pinned by row 2 of the members test).
- `packages/plugin-form/src/index.tsx`: the `details` registration goes from `{ name, type: 'array', required: true }` to the same plus `of: 'object'` and a description. ⚠️ This file is outside the claim's file surface; it is here because the dispatch asked for the `of` decision and the declaration lives on the registration, not on the parity row. The `required: true` is not touched (Acceptance note 1).
- `packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/masterDetailDetailsMembers-8071.test.tsx`: the header no longer says the spec row is `z.array(z.unknown())`; the compile-time block gains two rows — `derivedFromSpec` (the config `Equal`s the spec entry with `sortField` omitted, on 17.6.0 and on objectstack `main` alike: the `Omit` subtracts the key whether the entry declares it as a string or as a `retiredKey()` tombstone) and `columnsAreTheGridColumn` (a `columns` entry `Equal`s `GridColumn`) — and keeps `memberList` (the eleven keys spelled out) and the `@ts-expect-error` row on a written `sortField`. Patch round 1 (`999aecb6`) dropped a third row, `specStillDeclaresSortField`, which pinned the 17.6.0 shape and was red against objectstack `main` in the `Spec Main Shape Gate`. The runtime rows are unchanged.
- `packages/types/src/__tests__/object-master-detail-form-details-entry-11396.test.ts` (new; 7 `it` blocks, 19 tests: six rows on each of two faces, six cross-door rows, one non-vacuity row): a type-level row that the block's `properties.details` entry `Equal`s the spec's entry; on the tolerant face (`safeValidateSchema`, which `objectui validate` runs) and on the strict authoring face, for a node in the spec's `{ type, properties }` form: `{ childObject }` accepted (control); an undeclared entry key refused at `properties.details.0` with one `unrecognized_keys` naming it; no `childObject` refused with `invalid_type` at that member; a bare-string column refused at `properties.details.0.columns.0`; a column with an undeclared key refused there naming it; `sortField` ACCEPTED (the fork, recorded so that closing it is a deliberate flip). Plus one verdict across the two doors: for each probe, `safeValidateSchema` and the spec's own props row agree on success and on the issue codes at the same paths under `properties`.
- `apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts`: the `object-master-detail-form.details` member-pin prose. Every true sentence is kept, including the camelCase grid sentence objectui#11610 wrote; the last two sentences (the `z.array(z.unknown())` row, the five-of-eleven count, "declares no `of`") are replaced by the closed entry, the derivation, the fork and the `of`.
- `.changeset/11396-master-detail-details-entry.md`: empty frontmatter, with a body saying why nothing is released.

## Premise readings (this worktree, base `9dfaca65`, which is `origin/main` at PR time)

- After `pnpm install`, `packages/types` and `packages/plugin-form` both resolve `@objectstack/spec` at `17.6.0`; both declare `^17.6.0`.
- `ObjectMasterDetailFormPropsSchema.shape.details`, read off the installed schema: an OPTIONAL array of a `z.object` whose catchall is `never`. The entry's keys, in the schema's own order: `childObject` (string, required), then `relationshipField`, `columns`, `formFields`, `inlineMode`, `amountField`, `sortField`, `totalField`, `title`, `minRows`, `maxRows`, `addLabel`, each optional. `{}` is refused with `invalid_type` at `childObject`; `{ childObject: 'x', bogus: 1 }` is refused with `unrecognized_keys` naming `bogus`.
- `columns`: an array of a strict object whose key set equals that of `InlineGridColumnSchema` from `@objectstack/spec/data`, and whose `z.input` type `Equal`s `GridColumn` (which IS that `InlineGridColumn`), judged by `tsc`. ⚠️ Runtime identity does not hold across the published entry points: the entry's column element is not `===` `InlineGridColumnSchema` as `@objectstack/spec/data` exports it, and `@objectstack/spec/ui`'s own `InlineGridColumnSchema` export is not `===` the `data` one either — the `ui` bundle carries its own instance. The card's "by identity" is a statement about objectstack's source. Nothing here depends on identity (Acceptance note 2).
- `sortField` is NOT retired at 17.6.0: `{ childObject: 'x', sortField: 'a' }` parses with success and the value kept. objectstack `main` has retired it since — a `retiredKey()` tombstone on the entry (objectstack-ai/objectstack#21589, PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#21632, `6ec54f00`): `git merge-base --is-ancestor` answers 0 for that commit against objectstack `origin/main` and 1 against the `@objectstack/spec@17.6.0` tag, with `a29a0ea555` as the control answering 0 on the same tag — so the retirement is unreleased after 17.6.0. The fork therefore stands on the installed spec; the runtime pin records it, and the compile-time rows hold on both shapes.
- `inlineMode` is the enum `grid | form`, the same two values `InlineMode` declares; `formFields` is `string[]`; `title` and `addLabel` are plain strings (not `I18nLabel`); `minRows` / `maxRows` are numbers. So the derived members are the hand-written members' types.
- `ObjectMasterDetailFormPropsParsed` is exported alongside `ObjectMasterDetailFormProps` (the `z.input` face). The authoring face is the one callers write, so it is the one derived from; the parsed face differs only inside a column (`readonlyWhen` / `requiredWhen` normalised to Expression envelopes).
- `packages/types` needed no edit: `ObjectMasterDetailFormBlockSchema`'s `properties` is `propsBag(... stripImportedDefaults(SpecObjectMasterDetailFormPropsSchema))`, and the new pin measures a bogus entry key refused on both faces with the spec's own code at the spec's own path.

## The fork: `sortField`, reported and not absorbed

The spec entry declares `sortField`; `MasterDetailForm` reads no such member (objectui#11070 round 9 retired the authored override — the line-position field is DERIVED from the child object by `deriveDetail` — and row 2c of the members test pins that a written one reaches nothing); `MasterDetailDetailConfig` leaves it off; `objectui validate` ACCEPTS it, because `@object-ui/types` takes the row by reference. Per the seat ruling this is reported with its measurement, not widened or narrowed here:

- widening the TypeScript face to the full spec entry would declare, on the authoring face, a key the runtime does not honour;
- narrowing the zod face would be a consumer-side departure from the spec row the mirror exists to take by reference.

The spec-side retirement has landed on objectstack `main` (objectstack-ai/objectstack#21589, PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#21632, `6ec54f00`) and is unreleased after 17.6.0 (the card's section 3 recorded it as owed on objectstack-ai/objectstack#6017 before it landed). The fork closes at objectui's bump to the first `@objectstack/spec` release that carries it. One row reds at that bump and says what to do: the `sortField` ACCEPTED rows in the new types pin. It is a RUNTIME row on purpose: the `Spec Main Shape Gate` compiles this repository against objectstack `main`, so a compile-time row pinning the 17.6.0 shape is red there today — which is what patch round 1 corrected.

## The `of` decision

The parity file's own rule (`member declarations are derived from single-kind member contracts`): a key is declared with `of` when the contract accepts exactly ONE coarse member kind in its member position, and left alone when it accepts several. On 17.5.0 the `details` member position accepted every kind (`z.unknown()`), so no `of` was derivable. On 17.6.0 it accepts `object` alone — the string, number, boolean and array probes are refused with `invalid_type` at the entry — so `of: 'object'` is derivable, and the registration now declares it. The gate's member direction witnesses it against the spec row (the `object-master-detail-form.details:of=object` judgement is `witnessed`, and the single-kind row reads `contract accepts {object}`; the parity run below is green with the declaration in place). Precedent: `record:details.sections` declares `of: 'object'` for its strict spec entry. `object-kanban.columns` does not and is not this card.

## FROM → TO, proven once

A temporary test file (archived in the dispatch scratchpad, deleted before the commit) copied the HEAD interface byte for byte as `OldMasterDetailDetailConfig` and asserted `Equal` of OLD and NEW `= true`, beside a non-vacuity row asserting `Equal` of OLD and NEW-minus-`title` is `false`. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-form run type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) exited 0 with that file in the test program (`tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` names `masterDetailDetailsMembers-8071.test.tsx`, `MasterDetailForm.tsx` and the spec's `dist/ui/index.d.ts`). That is the whole of the `Clause-②: no`.

## Tests and the ablation

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-form/ apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts --maxWorkers=2` (under `os-verify-lock`): `Test Files 166 passed (166)`, `Tests 2190 passed | 1 skipped (2191)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/ --maxWorkers=2` (under the lock): `Test Files 358 passed (358)`, `Tests 9519 passed (9519)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- The three touched test files by name (under the lock): `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 283 passed (283)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-form run type-check` (both programs): `VERDICT command-exit 0`. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console run type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -b tsconfig.node.json --force`, after building the console's dependency closure with pnpm): `VERDICT command-exit 0`. The first console run was refused on an unbuilt `@object-ui/plugin-tree` (`TS2882`, outside the doc-snippets closure); building `plugin-tree` and `test-support` and rerunning gave the green above.
- **Ablation** (the fix committed first, as `a4ac1f38`; objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode over `MasterDetailForm.tsx`, child command `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit`):
  - A first attempt was a NO-OP by the tool's own evidence and is reported as such: anchor `'sortField'` with replacement `'sortField' | 'addLabel'` left the anchor count at 1 → 1, so the tool refused the mutation before running the child and restored (blob == HEAD). No reading was taken from it.
  - The real leg: anchor `'sortField'` → replacement `'addLabel'` (the derivation now omits `addLabel` instead). `anchor 1 -> 0`, `blob 2fa79a3713f6 -> 165e0f7923a5`, mutation proven on disk. The child went RED with five errors: the `derivedFromSpec` row and the `memberList` row (`Type 'true' is not assignable to type 'false'`), the `retiredSortField` row (`Unused '@ts-expect-error' directive`), and two renderer reads of `d.addLabel` in the grid hand-off (`Property 'addLabel' does not exist on type 'MasterDetailDetailConfig'`). Restore: `blob after restore 2fa79a3713f6`, `blob at HEAD 2fa79a3713f6`, `git diff HEAD empty`, `git status` clean. The rows and the renderer both hang off the derivation.
  - Resolution path: the test program compiles `../MasterDetailForm` from source and reads the spec from its installed `.d.ts`; no `dist/` of this package is in the path, so no dist preflight applies.

## Gate readings, at head `a4ac1f38`

Warnings: 0 on the parity file and on the new pin; on `MasterDetailForm.tsx`, the members test and `index.tsx` every warning is `no-explicit-any` on a pre-existing `any` line, `react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` or `react-refresh/only-export-components` on lines this diff does not touch.
  - This is a declared narrowing of `pnpm lint`. Population: `eslint.config.js` lints `**/*.{ts,tsx}`; the changeset `.md` is outside it. File count: 5, from the JSON output. Invariance: the config sets no `parserOptions.project` and no `projectService`, so type-aware linting is off and this diff cannot move the verdict on any untouched file. The full run belongs to CI.
- `check:doc-snippets`: `Semantic phase: 777 of 777 block(s) judged, 0 failed`.
- `check:new-line-citations`: `0 new citation(s)`. `check:control-bytes`: OK.
- Changeset checkers, exit 0 each: `changeset:check` (fixed and no-major), `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check-changeset-presence` ("Every one of them has an EMPTY frontmatter — declared as releasing nothing"), `check-changeset-overwrite`.
- Exit 0 each: `check:spec-symbols`, `check:spec-floors` (first refused `no-artifact` on the unbuilt `plugin-tree`; green after the build above), `check:installed-pin-claims`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:unused-deps`, `check:readme-exports`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:component-surface-parity`, `check:doc-types`.
- `check-governed-queue-guard --test` over the six paths: NOT GOVERNED.
- NOT MEASURED, left to CI: the full `pnpm test`, the tree-wide `pnpm lint`, `check:published-dist`.

## Acceptance notes

1. **`details` is optional on the spec row and required on the registration and the TypeScript face.** The spec's `details` is `z.ZodOptional`; the registration declares `required: true` (kept as it was), `MasterDetailFormSchema.details` is required, and the renderer itself tolerates absence (`schema.details || []`). objectui#11605 records the mechanism by which a `required: true` the spec row does not carry refuses a node at the page compile ("its only requiredness check is `input.required && !(input.name in node)`"); that card's rule is about binding-supplied keys, which this one is not. Not measured through the page compile here, and not this card. Carrier: none.
2. **Two instances of `InlineGridColumnSchema` across `@objectstack/spec`'s published entry points** (Premise readings). Any objectui pin that asserts cross-entry-point identity would be false; none does today, and this PR adds none. Carrier: none.
3. **The registration's new description** is authoring help for the manifest and the designer; the member SHAPE is carried by `of` and by the pins, not by that prose. It names the two things the spec's description cannot tell an author: `amountField` is the child column summed and `totalField` the parent field it is saved to, and `sortField` is read by nothing here.

## Patch round 1 — `999aecb6` (seat ruling `5986267745`)

The `Spec Main Shape Gate` was red on `a4ac1f38` with one attributed diagnostic: `masterDetailDetailsMembers-8071.test.tsx`, TS2322, compiled against `@objectstack/spec` built from objectstack `ebfe658c7241`. Confirmed: objectstack `main` carries `sortField: retiredKey(MASTER_DETAIL_DETAIL_SORT_FIELD_RETIRED)` on the detail entry (`retiredKey()` is `z.never().optional()`), from objectstack-ai/objectstack#21589 / PR #21632 / `6ec54f00`, which is an ancestor of `origin/main` and not of the `@objectstack/spec@17.6.0` tag (control: `a29a0ea555` is an ancestor of the tag). The row `specStillDeclaresSortField` pinned the 17.6.0 shape and failed there.

- Rows: `specStillDeclaresSortField` dropped. `derivedFromSpec`, `columnsAreTheGridColumn`, `memberList` and the `@ts-expect-error` row stay, and hold on both shapes (measured below). The forward tripwire is the runtime `sortField` ACCEPTED pin in `packages/types`, renamed to say so; it flips at the bump.
- Sentences: the `MasterDetailForm.tsx` docblock, the members-test header, the types-pin header, the registration description, the console parity row and the changeset body now say the retirement landed on objectstack `main`, is unreleased after 17.6.0, and that the fork closes at objectui's bump to the first release carrying it.
- Local reproduction of the gate, with the spec built from objectstack `main` `e83c9f615441` in a scratch worktree (packed with `npm pack`, injected with `scripts/spec-main-shape-gate.mjs inject`; `no dependency substitution`), `TURBO_FORCE=true` and a scratch `--cache-dir`, under `os-verify-lock`:
  - RED (declared narrowing: turbo filtered to `@object-ui/plugin-form`, the attributed test file checked out from `a4ac1f38` while HEAD held the fix): `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/plugin-form --concurrency=2 --continue` exited 2; the gate's `report` printed `1 diagnostic(s) in 1 objectui file(s)` — the members test, TS2322 `Type 'true' is not assignable to type 'false'`. Restore proven: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
  - GREEN (the gate's full step, on `999aecb6`): `pnpm type-check --continue --concurrency=2` — `Tasks: 81 successful, 81 total`, `Cached: 0 cached`, 9m26s; `report`: `✅ objectui type-checks against @objectstack/spec at that commit`.
- Back on 17.6.0 (reinstalled; `0` inject markers in the store): plugin-form closure rebuilt, `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-form run type-check` exit 0, the three touched test files `3 passed`, `283` tests, `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console run type-check` exit 0.
- `Clause-②: no` re-measured on `999aecb6`: the pre-PR interface at `9dfaca65`, byte-copied, `Equal`s the derived type (`tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` exit 0, temp file deleted before push).
- Ablation redone on `999aecb6` (anchor `'sortField'` → `'addLabel'`): mutation landed (`anchor 1 -> 0`, blob changed), five errors — `derivedFromSpec`, `memberList`, the unused `@ts-expect-error`, two renderer reads of `d.addLabel` — restore proven (blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty).
- Gates on `999aecb6`, exit 0 each: eslint over the five touched TypeScript files (0 errors), `check:installed-pin-claims`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `changeset:check`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-overwrite`.

Serial: objectui#11170 was dispatched in this lane during this round and shares no file with this PR. `origin/main` has not moved since this branch was fast-forwarded to `9dfaca65`, so the merge before pushing was a no-op in both rounds.
